content_data.meeting_title: Content Strategy Alignment for New Client Onboarding
agenda_items: Review of new entertainment client's brand guidelines and strategic objectives
Establishing key messaging and brand voice parameters
Discussion on initial content requirements and storytelling angles
Defining content workflow and approval processes for sensitive information
key_decisions: Develop a tailored content calendar for the initial 3 months, focusing on foundational pieces.
Implement a tiered content approval system to ensure security compliance.
action_items: Content Writer (Amara Khan): Research competitor content strategies in the regional entertainment security sector over the next 7 days.
Client Liaison (Ben Carter): Confirm client's preferred communication channels and tone of voice by next Monday.
Security Consultant (Dr. Mei Lin): Provide detailed guidelines for secure content creation and distribution within 5 days.
Content Writer (Amara Khan): Draft initial narrative brief and key message document by end of next week.
